title: China's Highest Crater Lake Is Clear Only ~50 Days a Year | China Travel Expert
description:
China's highest crater lake is clear maybe fifty days a year — climb on the wrong day and you see nothing but cloud.

Tianchi — "Heaven Lake" — sits in the caldera of Changbai Mountain at about 2,189 m, formed by a huge eruption over a thousand years ago, and it's the deepest and highest alpine crater lake in China. The catch: access shuts for strong wind, rain, fog and snow, and clouds roll in most days — some estimates put the clear-sky view at only about 50 days a year.

🧭 Expert Tip: hike up before 10 AM — the clouds usually gather by midday, so an early start is your best shot at the sapphire view.

中国最高的火山口湖，一年只晴约50天——多数日子只有云雾，上山要趁早。
